name: Window
remarks: Many worksheet characteristics, such as scroll bars and gridlines, are actually properties of the window. The Window object is a member of the Windows collection. The Windows collection for the Application object contains all the windows in the application, whereas the Windows collection for the Workbook object contains only the windows in the specified workbook.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveCell
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the active cell in the active window (the window on top) or in the specified window. If the window isn't displaying a worksheet, this property fails. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveChart
properties.description: Returns a Chart object that represents the active chart (either an embedded chart or a chart sheet). An embedded chart is considered active when it's either selected or activated. When no chart is active, this property returns Nothing.

properties.name: ActivePane
properties.description: Returns a Pane object that represents the active pane in the window. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveSheet
properties.description: Returns an object that represents the active sheet (the sheet on top) in the active workbook or in the specified window or workbook. Returns Nothing if no sheet is active.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the name that appears in the title bar of the document window.

properties.name: DisplayFormulas
properties.description: True if the window is displaying formulas; False if the window is displaying values. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayGridlines
properties.description: True if gridlines are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayHeadings
properties.description: True if both row and column headings are displayed; False if no headings are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayHorizontalScrollBar
properties.description: True if the horizontal scroll bar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayOutline
properties.description: True if outline symbols are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayVerticalScrollBar
properties.description: True if the vertical scroll bar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayWorkbookTabs
properties.description: True if the workbook tabs are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayZeros
properties.description: True if zero values are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableResize
properties.description: True if the window can be resized. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FreezePanes
properties.description: True if split panes are frozen. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: GridlineColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the gridline color as an RGB value. Read/write Long.

properties.name: GridlineColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the gridline color as an index into the current color palette or as an XlColorIndex constant.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the window.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the client area to the left edge of the window.

properties.name: OnWindow
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the procedure that's run whenever you activate a window. Read/write String.

properties.name: Panes
properties.description: Returns a Panes collection that represents all the panes in the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: RangeSelection
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the selected cells on the worksheet in the specified window even if a graphic object is active or selected on the worksheet. Read-only.

properties.name: ScrollColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of the leftmost column in the pane or window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ScrollRow
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of the row that appears at the top of the pane or window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: SelectedSheets
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the selected sheets in the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: Selection
properties.description: Returns the specified window, for a Windows object.

properties.name: Split
properties.description: True if the window is split. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SplitColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets the column number where the window is split into panes (the number of columns to the left of the split line). Read/write Long.

properties.name: SplitHorizontal
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of the horizontal window split, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: SplitRow
properties.description: Returns or sets the row number where the window is split into panes (the number of rows above the split). Read/write Long.

properties.name: SplitVertical
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of the vertical window split, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: TabRatio
properties.description: Returns or sets the ratio of the width of the workbook's tab area to the width of the window's horizontal scroll bar (as a number between 0 (zero) and 1; the default value is 0.6). Read/write Double.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the window to the top edge of the usable area (below the menus, any toolbars docked at the top, and the formula bar).

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlWindowType value that represents the window type.

properties.name: UsableHeight
properties.description: Returns the maximum height of the space that a window can occupy in the application window area, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: UsableWidth
properties.description: Returns the maximum width of the space that a window can occupy in the application window area, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: VisibleRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range of cells that are visible in the window or pane. If a column or row is partially visible, it's included in the range. Read-only.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the width, in points, of the window.

properties.name: WindowNumber
properties.description: Returns the window number. For example, a window named Book1.xls:2 has 2 as its window number. Most windows have the window number 1. Read-only Long.

properties.name: WindowState
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the window. Read/write XlWindowState.

properties.name: Zoom
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the display size of the window, as a percentage (100 equals normal size, 200 equals double size, and so on).

properties.name: View
properties.description: Returns or sets the view showing in the window. Read/write XlWindowView.

properties.name: DisplayRightToLeft
properties.description: True if the specified window is displayed from right to left instead of from left to right. False if the object is displayed from left to right. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: SheetViews
properties.description: Returns the SheetViews object for the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveSheetView
properties.description: Returns an object that represents the view of the active sheet in the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayRuler
properties.description: True if a ruler is displayed for the specified window. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoFilterDateGrouping
properties.description: True if the auto filter for date grouping is currently displayed in the specified window. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayWhitespace
properties.description: True if whitespace is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Hwnd
properties.description: Returns a Long that indicates the window handle of the specified window. Read-only.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Brings the window to the front of the z-order.

methods.name: ActivateNext
methods.description: Activates the specified window and then sends it to the back of the window z-order.

methods.name: ActivatePrevious
methods.description: Activates the specified window and then activates the window at the back of the window z-order.

methods.name: Close
methods.signature: Close([SaveChanges As Variant], [Filename As Variant], [RouteWorkbook As Variant]) As Boolean

parameters.name: SaveChanges
parameters.description: If there are no changes to the workbook, this argument is ignored. If there are changes to the workbook and the workbook appears in other open windows, this argument is ignored. If there are changes to the workbook but the workbook doesn't appear in any other open windows, this argument specifies whether changes should be saved.If set to True, changes are saved to the workbook. If there is not yet a file name associated with the workbook, _FileName_ is used. If _FileName_ is omitted, the user is asked to supply a file name.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: Save changes under this file name.

parameters.name: RouteWorkbook
parameters.description: If the workbook doesn't need to be routed to the next recipient (if it has no routing slip or has already been routed), this argument is ignored. Otherwise, Microsoft Excel routes the workbook according to the value of this parameter. If set to True, the workbook is sent to the next recipient. If set to False, the workbook is not sent. If omitted, the user is asked whether the workbook should be sent.

methods.name: LargeScroll
methods.signature: LargeScroll([Down As Variant], [Up As Variant], [ToRight As Variant], [ToLeft As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Scrolls the contents of the window by pages.

parameters.name: Down
parameters.description: The number of pages to scroll the contents down.

parameters.name: Up
parameters.description: The number of pages to scroll the contents up.

parameters.name: ToRight
parameters.description: The number of pages to scroll the contents to the right.

parameters.name: ToLeft
parameters.description: The number of pages to scroll the contents to the left.

methods.name: NewWindow
methods.description: Creates a new window or a copy of the specified window.

methods.name: PrintPreview
methods.description: Shows a preview of the object as it would look when printed.

parameters.name: EnableChanges
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to specify if the user can change the margins and other page setup options available in print preview.

methods.name: ScrollWorkbookTabs
methods.signature: ScrollWorkbookTabs([Sheets As Variant], [Position As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Scrolls through the workbook tabs at the bottom of the window. Doesn't affect the active sheet in the workbook.

parameters.name: Sheets
parameters.description: The number of sheets to scroll by. Use a positive number to scroll forward, a negative number to scroll backward, or 0 (zero) to not scroll at all. You must specify _Sheets_ if you don't specify _Position_.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Use xlFirst to scroll to the first sheet, or use xlLast to scroll to the last sheet. You must specify _Position_ if you don't specify _Sheets_.

methods.name: SmallScroll
methods.signature: SmallScroll([Down As Variant], [Up As Variant], [ToRight As Variant], [ToLeft As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Scrolls the contents of the window by rows or columns.

parameters.name: Down
parameters.description: The number of rows to scroll the contents down.

parameters.name: Up
parameters.description: The number of rows to scroll the contents up.

parameters.name: ToRight
parameters.description: The number of columns to scroll the contents to the right.

parameters.name: ToLeft
parameters.description: The number of columns to scroll the contents to the left.

methods.name: PointsToScreenPixelsX
methods.description: Converts a horizontal measurement from points (document coordinates) to screen pixels (screen coordinates). Returns the converted measurement as a Long value.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The number of points horizontally along the top of the document window, starting from the left.

methods.name: PointsToScreenPixelsY
methods.description: Converts a vertical measurement from points (document coordinates) to screen pixels (screen coordinates). Returns the converted measurement as a Long value.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The number of points vertically along the left edge of the document window, starting from the top.

methods.name: RangeFromPoint
methods.signature: RangeFromPoint(x As Long, y As Long) As Object
methods.description: Returns the Shape or Range object that is positioned at the specified pair of screen coordinates. If there isn't a shape located at the specified coordinates, this method returns Nothing.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The value (in pixels) that represents the horizontal distance from the left edge of the screen, starting at the top.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The value (in pixels) that represents the vertical distance from the top of the screen, starting on the left.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.signature: ScrollIntoView(Left As Long, Top As Long, Width As Long, Height As Long, [Start As Variant])
methods.description: Scrolls the document window so that the contents of a specified rectangular area are displayed in either the upper-left or lower-right corner of the document window or pane (depending on the value of the _Start_ argument).

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The horizontal position of the rectangle (in points) from the left edge of the document window or pane.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The vertical position of the rectangle (in points) from the top of the document window or pane.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the rectangle, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the rectangle, in points.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: True to have the upper-left corner of the rectangle appear in the upper-left corner of the document window or pane. False to have the lower-right corner of the rectangle appear in the lower-right corner of the document window or pane. The default value is True.

methods.name: PrintOut
methods.signature: PrintOut([From As Variant], [To As Variant], [Copies As Variant], [Preview As Variant], [ActivePrinter As Variant], [PrintToFile As Variant], [Collate As Variant], [PrToFileName As Variant]) As Variant

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The number of the page at which to start printing. If this argument is omitted, printing starts at the beginning.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The number of the last page to print. If this argument is omitted, printing ends with the last page.

parameters.name: Copies
parameters.description: The number of copies to print. If this argument is omitted, one copy is printed.

parameters.name: Preview
parameters.description: True to have Microsoft Excel invoke print preview before printing the object. False (or omitted) to print the object immediately.

parameters.name: ActivePrinter
parameters.description: Sets the name of the active printer.

parameters.name: PrintToFile
parameters.description: True to print to a file. If _PrToFileName_ is not specified, Microsoft Excel prompts the user to enter the name of the output file.

parameters.name: Collate
parameters.description: True to collate multiple copies.

parameters.name: PrToFileName
parameters.description: If _PrintToFile_ is set to True, this argument specifies the name of the file that you want to print to.
